property.name: The Grand Azure Heritage Resort & Spa
property.tagline: Luxury beachfront hospitality on Candolim Beach, Goa
property.address: Candolim Beach Road, Fort Aguada Area, Candolim, North Goa 403515, India

amenities.name: Oceanview Infinity Pool
amenities.description: Temperature-controlled outdoor infinity pool overlooking the Arabian Sea, with complimentary pool towels, sun loungers, and poolside coconut water & beverage service.

amenities.name: AyurVeda Spa & Fitness Center
amenities.hours: Spa: 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM | Gym: 24/7 access with room key card
amenities.description: Authentic Kerala Ayurvedic treatments, steam, sauna, and modern fitness center with premium cardio, strength training, and yoga mats.

amenities.name: Complimentary Royal Buffet Breakfast
amenities.hours: 7:00 AM - 10:30 AM daily (until 11:00 AM on Sundays)
amenities.description: Extensive gourmet buffet included with all bookings. Features South Indian specialties (idli, medu vada, live dosa counter), North Indian favorites (stuffed parathas, poori bhaji), live egg counter, continental bakery, filter coffee, and masala chai. Dedicated Pure Veg and Jain sections available.

amenities.name: High-Speed Wi-Fi
amenities.description: Complimentary 500 Mbps high-speed fiber Wi-Fi across all guest rooms, gardens, conference halls, and poolside.

amenities.name: Valet & EV Parking
amenities.description: Complimentary covered parking for resident guests with 24/7 security and dual Tata Power / universal EV fast-charging stations.

amenities.name: Saffron Coastal & Spice Restaurant
amenities.hours: Lunch: 12:30 PM - 3:30 PM | Dinner: 7:00 PM - 11:00 PM
amenities.description: Fine-dining restaurant serving authentic Goan seafood delicacies, North Indian tandoor, Mughlai curries, and regional thalis, with a separate pure vegetarian kitchen section.

rooms.description: Elegant 320 sq ft room with courtyard garden view, Queen plush mattress, Italian marble bathroom with rainfall shower, 55-inch 4K Smart TV, tea/coffee maker, and workstation.

rooms.bedType: 1 King Bed + 1 Rollaway bed available on request
rooms.description: Spacious 460 sq ft room with private balcony overlooking the Arabian Sea, King plush mattress, deep soaking bathtub, mini-bar, and cozy lounge sofa.
Expansive 750 sq ft two-bedroom suite with Arabian Sea view, separate living and dining rooms, two full en-suite bathrooms, and private sundeck balcony.
Royal 1,300 sq ft penthouse villa with panoramic 360-degree ocean views, private rooftop plunge pool, jacuzzi, personal butler service, and private cocktail bar.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 24 hours prior to scheduled check-in (2:00 PM IST). Cancellations made within 24 hours incur a charge equal to the first night's room rate.
policies.checkInCheckOut: Standard check-in begins at 2:00 PM. Check-out is by 11:00 AM. Early check-in (from 10:00 AM) and late check-out (up to 2:00 PM) are subject to room availability upon request.
policies.idVerification: In accordance with Government of India regulations, a valid government-issued photo ID with address (Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving License) is mandatory for every adult guest during check-in. PAN cards are not accepted as valid proof of address.
policies.pets: Pets are strictly not allowed on resort premises, with the sole exception of certified service animals with valid veterinary and training documentation.
policies.children: Children up to 5 years old stay complimentary when sharing existing bedding with parents. An extra rollaway bed for children aged 6 to 12 years is available for ₹1,200 per night.
policies.smoking: All guest rooms, suites, and enclosed indoor premises are strictly 100% smoke-free. A deep-cleaning sanitation fee of ₹5,000 applies for smoking inside rooms. Designated open-air smoking zones are available on property grounds.
policies.payment: We accept UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), RuPay, Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and corporate direct billing. Valid GST details can be provided at check-in for tax invoicing.

faqs.a: Standard check-in begins at 2:00 PM IST. Early check-in starting from 10:00 AM can be arranged subject to room availability.
Check-out time is by 11:00 AM IST. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be requested at the front desk, subject to availability.

faqs.q: Does the hotel have a swimming pool?
faqs.a: Yes! The resort features a temperature-controlled outdoor oceanview infinity pool overlooking Candolim Beach, open daily from 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM with complimentary towels and poolside beverage service.

Yes, complimentary Royal Buffet Breakfast is included for all registered hotel guests daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM (until 11:00 AM on Sundays), featuring South Indian, North Indian, continental, and dedicated pure vegetarian & Jain options.

faqs.q: Which room is suitable for three guests?
faqs.a: Our Deluxe King Room (max 3 guests with a rollaway extra bed on request) or our Family Executive Suite (max 4 guests with 1 King and 2 Twin beds in separate rooms) are ideal choices.
We offer free cancellation up to 24 hours prior to check-in (2:00 PM IST). Cancellations made within 24 hours incur a charge for the first night.
Yes, we provide complimentary on-site covered parking with 24/7 security and Tata Power / universal EV charging stations for resident guests. Complimentary valet service is also provided.
Pets are strictly not allowed on resort grounds, except for certified service animals with valid documentation.

faqs.q: What government ID is required at check-in?
faqs.a: As per Government of India guidelines, all adult guests must present an original government-issued photo ID with address proof (Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving License). PAN cards are not accepted as proof of address.

faqs.q: Is pure vegetarian and Jain food available?
faqs.a: Yes, our Saffron Coastal & Spice restaurant maintains a separate dedicated pure vegetarian kitchen area and serves authentic Jain dishes (prepared without onion or garlic) upon request.
